answer: What survives to the ivory is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The anchor is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the mesa. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, clawed back after a replayed submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
